verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets users write corrections with routing conditions that are delivered automatically when a matching situation recurs, and its SDK uploads captures in the background. These are context-injection and telemetry behaviors, not user-configurable automations that run autonomous tasks in the background. The pack documents no workflow, trigger, or scheduled-automation feature, so the support is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
